diagram_math_checks.details: The five vertices are (0)A_m, (x)A_m, (y)A_m, (x+y)A_m and mA_m. For A=k[x,y] over a field, A is a domain; quotients by (x), (y), (x+y) are k[y], k[x], k[x] respectively, while A/m=k. Thus all five source ideals are prime and contained in m, agreeing with Example and Verification 1.1 (with m from Given).

For iota:A -> A_m, extension q -> q A_m has domain the prime ideals q contained in m and codomain Spec(A_m). Contraction P -> iota^{-1}(P) has domain Spec(A_m) and returns such q. cor-primes-of-a-prime-local-ring Statement and its L2 supplier lem-primes-of-a-localisation-avoid-the-multiplicative-set Statement and steps 1.1-1.2 give mutual inverse inclusion-preserving operations; no ring map in the reverse direction is asserted.

The three lower edges assert (0) is strictly contained in each of (x), (y), (x+y); nonzero generators establish strictness. The three upper edges assert each is strictly contained in m: modulo (x), y remains nonzero; modulo (y), x remains nonzero; modulo (x+y), x remains nonzero. The bijection preserves strict inclusion, so these six relations hold for the extended ideals. Upward edges are undirected poset edges with orientation defined in prose, not algebra homomorphisms.

Modulo (x), y and x+y both map to nonzero y; modulo (y), x and x+y both map to nonzero x; modulo (x+y), x and y map to nonzero x and -x, including characteristic two. This excludes each containment between distinct middle ideals. Contraction reflects containment, so incomparability survives extension. Only the selected finite subposet is displayed; no assertion of exhaustion or of saturated prime chains in the entire spectrum is made. Actual image has five labelled nodes and all six drawn edges.
